content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Kamdhenu University Field Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for Kamdhenu University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Field Assistant. This is a contract-based position for a research scheme.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Field Assistant post in Kamdhenu University Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Field Assistant post is a Diploma in Animal Husbandry.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Field Assistant position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Field Assistant position is Rs. 20,000 plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is a maximum of 40 years for male candidates and 45 years for female candidates.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 17 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at the College of Veterinary Science & A.H., Kamdhenu University, Rajpur (Nava) Himmatnagar.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, a set of self-attested photocopies, and a bio-data on plain paper.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.
